---
title: "Glue pairs"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup-glue-pairs
#| include: false
source("R/site.R")
source("R/edges.R")
library(DT)
status <- stat_table("status")
open_numbers <- stat_table("open")
# The full per-edge table is only in a local build (`make preview`), never on the public site.
edges <- if (file.exists("generated/edges.csv")) read_edges("generated/edges.csv")
```

Every edge number is printed twice in the template: once on the edge and once on the tab that is glued to it. The converter measures the edge each number sits on and pairs the two. A pair *matches* when it found exactly one edge and one tab of the same length (status `ok`).

```{r}
#| label: glue-pairs-summary
#| output: asis
if (is.null(NUMBERS)) {
  cat("No summary statistics are committed yet (`make report-data`).\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("%d of %d printed numbers match their partner. The %d still open are shown below, by page and by what went wrong.\n",
              stat("matching"), stat("numbers"), stat("needs_work")))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-open-numbers
#| fig-cap: "Edge numbers that still need a look, per PDF page, by reason."
#| fig-height: 3.4
if (!is.null(open_numbers) && nrow(open_numbers) > 0) {
  open_numbers |>
    mutate(page = factor(sprintf("%02d", page)), status = fct_reorder(status, n, sum, .desc = TRUE)) |>
    ggplot(aes(page, n, fill = status)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = unname(HI[c("orange", "blue", "teal", "yellow", "red", "pink")])) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    labs(x = "page", y = "open edge numbers", fill = NULL) +
    theme_hi() +
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-open-reasons
#| tbl-cap: "What each reason means."
REASONS <- c(
  `unpaired` = "No other copy of this number was found: most likely misread.",
  `extra copy: likely misread` = "Read more than twice; the other copies already form a clean pair.",
  `printed 3 times` = "Read three times with no clean pair among them.",
  `printed 4 times` = "Read four times with no clean pair among them.",
  `length mismatch` = "Partner found, but the two marked lines differ in length.",
  `no tab` = "Neither copy sits on a tab fold.",
  `both tabs` = "Both copies sit on a tab fold.",
  `line not found` = "No edge line was found under the number."
)
if (!is.null(status)) {
  status |>
    filter(verdict == "needs work") |>
    arrange(desc(n)) |>
    transmute(Reason = status, Numbers = n, Meaning = unname(REASONS[status])) |>
    knitr::kable()
}
```

```{r}
#| label: glue-pairs-local
#| output: asis
if (!is.null(edges)) cat("## Every pair\n\nLocal build only. `A` is the first piece of the pair, `B` its partner, lengths in mm.\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: glue-pairs-table
#| column: page-right
if (!is.null(edges)) {
  glue_pairs(edges) |>
    mutate(across(c(verdict, status, side_a, side_b, ocr_a), factor)) |>
    datatable(
      rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", class = "compact stripe",
      colnames = c("Number", "Verdict", "Status", "Piece A", "Side A", "Length A",
                   "Piece B", "Side B", "Length B", "Diff", "A read"),
      options = list(pageLength = 25)
    ) |>
    formatStyle("verdict", color = styleEqual(c("matching", "needs work"), unname(VERDICT_COLOURS)),
                fontWeight = "bold")
}
```
